name: @matatbread/matbot-host-node
description: What a Node application needs to embed matbot that core cannot hold, being Node-only: AsyncLocalStorage principal and usage carriers, the module hooks that load matbot's TypeScript-source packages, plugin loading from disk, and a .env-file vault.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
